title: Chocolate Pistachio Biscotti
steps: Cream butter and sugars; beat in eggs and both extracts. Mix in flour, baking powder and salt, then chopped dough pistachios and chocolate.

Shape 3 logs about 10 cm wide on lined trays. Bake at 170°C for 25 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, slice 2 cm thick and bake for 10 minutes on each cut side. Cool, dip in melted topping chocolate and sprinkle with topping pistachios.

title: Spiced White Chocolate Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in dry ingredients and chopped dough chocolate. Shape 40 g balls and flatten slightly on lined trays. Bake at 180°C for 12–15 minutes. Cool and drizzle with melted topping chocolate.

title: Strawberry Cream Cookie Cups
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in the chocolate.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hours, or overnight.
Grease mini muffin tins, including rims. Add a tablespoon of dough per cup and bake at 175°C for 10–13 minutes. Cool briefly, loosen and remove; cool completely.
Whip cream with vanilla sugar and icing sugar. Pipe onto cookies, add trimmed strawberries and a dot of cream. Refrigerate until serving.

title: Apricot White Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Cream butter with both sugars and vanilla sugar; beat in eggs individually. Mix in oats, flour, cinnamon, salt and baking powder, then chopped apricots and chocolate.
Space heaped tablespoons on lined trays. Bake at 170°C fan or 190°C conventional for 13–15 minutes.

title: Classic Gingerbread Cookies
steps: Heat butter, brown sugar, syrup and spices with baking soda, stirring until boiling. Remove from heat; mix in egg and flour. Knead, roll out and cut shapes.
Bake at 200°C for about 10 minutes. Remove from the tray while warm. Mix icing white with sifted icing sugar until thick but flowing; decorate cooled cookies.

title: Lemon Chocolate Egg Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugar; beat in egg, extracts, lemon juice and zest. Mix in dry ingredients and roughly chopped chocolate eggs.
Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C for 12–15 minutes; cool.

title: Classic Sarah Bernhardt Cookies
steps: Boil water and sugar for 5–7 minutes into syrup; cool. Beat yolks until pale, gradually add syrup, then soft butter, cocoa and finely crushed coffee. Chill the filling.
Whisk whites, gradually adding icing sugar, until stiff. Fold in finely ground almonds; pipe small rounds on lined trays. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes and cool completely.
Pipe filling onto bases and chill. Melt coating chocolate with oil, dip the filled cookies and store chilled or frozen.

title: Chocolate Cookie Mascarpone Cake
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda, salt and chocolate. Chill dough for at least 1 hour. Bake spaced tablespoon portions at 170°C fan or 190°C conventional for 10–12 minutes; cool completely.

Whip cold cream, mascarpone, icing sugar and filling vanilla to soft peaks. Layer cookies with cream on a plate, making progressively smaller layers. Cover loosely and chill for 4–6 hours before slicing.

title: Spiced Cookies with Brown Butter Cream
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in dry ingredients gradually, using only enough flour for workable dough. Knead, roll out and cut cookies. Bake at 180°C for about 10 minutes; cool.

Brown half the filling butter for 2–3 minutes; cool. Melt white chocolate with cream and cool. Beat with remaining filling butter, cream cheese, maple syrup and filling vanilla; add icing sugar gradually to thicken. Sandwich cookies with filling and refrigerate.

title: Banana Oat Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugars; beat in egg, mashed banana and vanilla. Mix in flour, oats, baking soda and salt, adding a little extra oats or flour if too soft.
Space tablespoon portions on lined trays. Bake low in the oven at 180°C for 6–10 minutes, until just beginning to brown; cool briefly.

title: Savory Cheddar Pretzel Cookies
steps: Brown butter gently and cool. Combine flour, salt and baking powder; mix in butter and eggs, then grated cheese and broken pretzels. Add water if the dough is too stiff.
Shape small balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes until golden.

title: Brown Butter Pretzel Chocolate Cookies
steps: Brown butter gently and cool. Mix with sugar, eggs and vanilla; add flour, salt and baking powder. Fold in chocolate and broken pretzels.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes; cool.

title: Coconut Lemon Macaroons with Sweetener
steps: Beat eggs, sweetener, vanilla and lemon zest. Mix in melted butter and coconut; rest for 10–15 minutes. Form 20 small cones on parchment.
Bake at 175°C for 8–10 minutes until golden.

title: Chocolate-Coated Licorice Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in dry ingredients, then dough chocolate and chocolate-coated licorice. Place teaspoon portions on lined trays. Bake at 180°C fan for 8–10 minutes. Cool and drizzle with melted topping chocolate.

title: Soft Dark Chocolate Chunk Cookies
steps: Partially melt butter for about 30 seconds in the microwave. Beat with sugars until pale, then add egg and vanilla. Briefly mix in flour, baking soda and salt; fold in chopped chocolate.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C fan for 10 minutes; cool.

title: Thin Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda and salt, then 300 g chocolate chips. Space tablespoon portions on lined trays and top with remaining 100 g chips.
Bake at 180°C fan or 200°C conventional for 10–12 minutes. For thinner cookies, gently tap the tray halfway through baking. Cool on a rack.

title: No-Bake Gingerbread Oat Balls
steps: Cream butter and sugar, then mix in all remaining dough ingredients. Roll into small balls and coat in decorating sugar or coconut. Keep refrigerated in a sealed container.

title: Sarah Bernhardt Bars with Sweetener
steps: Whisk base whites and sweetener until stiff; fold in almond flour. Spread in a lined 30 × 25 cm tin. Bake at 150°C conventional for about 40 minutes; cool.
Beat filling sweetener, yolks, butter, cocoa and coffee together. Spread on cooled base and freeze. Melt chocolate, cool slightly and spread over filling. Let set, cut and store frozen.

title: Peanut Butter Rolo Cookies
steps: Melt butter and mix with brown sugar; add egg and peanut butter, then remaining ingredients, chopping Rolo into halves or smaller pieces. Chill for 1 hour.
Form small balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180°C fan for 10–12 minutes. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes before moving.

title: Cinnamon Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in syrup, then flour, baking soda, spices and salt. Fold in oats and chopped chocolate.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes; cool.
Leave on trays for at least 10 minutes before moving.

title: Pepper Licorice Chocolate Cookies
steps: Melt 100 g butter and freeze for 15 minutes until set. Beat with remaining butter, sugar and vanilla; add eggs individually.
Mix in flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt and coffee. Fold in chopped chocolate and licorice. Shape equal balls on lined trays; bake at 160°C for 8 minutes and cool before moving.

title: Nutella-Filled Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Beat in peanut butter, then dry ingredients, using only enough flour for firm but workable dough. Form small balls and flatten on lined trays.
Bake at 180°C for 5 minutes. Press wells into the centers and bake for another 7 minutes. Fill with Nutella and cool.

title: Caramel Pecan Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Add dough syrup, flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt; fold in chopped chocolate, pecans and oats. Shape 30 g balls on lined trays and bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes. Cool for 15 minutes.
Gently melt caramels with cream and topping syrup. Drizzle over cookies.

title: Red Velvet Cream Cheese Crinkles
steps: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Beat cream cheese with butter; add eggs and red coloring. Gradually mix in dry ingredients.
Roll small balls in icing sugar, place on lined trays and bake at 180°C for 10–15 minutes depending on size.

title: Frozen Skyr Kisses
steps: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Pipe small kisses onto parchment and freeze for 20–30 minutes until solid. Store frozen and serve straight from the freezer.

title: Cream Cheese Peppermint Buttons
steps: Beat cream cheese until smooth; add peppermint extract and optional stevia. Gradually beat in powdered sweetener and knead briefly.
Shape small balls on parchment and flatten with a fork. Dry uncovered for 2–3 hours, then refrigerate in an airtight container.

title: Chocolate Almond Coffee Biscotti
steps: Cream butter, sugars and coffee; beat in eggs. Mix in flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon, then chopped almonds and chocolate. Knead lightly on a floured surface.
Shape 3 logs about 10 cm wide. Bake at 170°C for 25 minutes; rest 10 minutes. Cut 2 cm slices, bake cut-side up for 10 minutes, turn and bake another 10 minutes. Cool until crisp.

title: Maple Coconut Almond Cookies
steps: Mix dry ingredients, then add syrup, soft butter and vanilla. Shape small balls on lined trays and flatten the tops. Bake at 180°C for about 15 minutes, longer if desired for crispness. Cool.
Optionally dip cooled cookies in melted chocolate and refrigerate until set.

title: Salted Caramel Pretzel Thumbprints
steps: Separate the whole egg and reserve its white with the extra white. Cream butter and sugars; beat in yolk, vanilla and sour milk. Mix in flour, cocoa and salt. Cover and chill for 30 minutes.
Roll 20 g balls in beaten whites and finely chopped pecans and pretzels. Place on parchment, indent centers and bake at 180°C for 10 minutes. Deepen wells while hot; cool.
Melt caramels with cream and fill wells. Sprinkle with sea salt, drizzle with melted chocolate and let set.

title: Peppermint Brownie Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Beat in peppermint extract. Mix in flour, cocoa, coffee, baking soda and salt, then chopped dough chocolate. Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight.
Shape balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake at 170°C for 10 minutes. Cool completely; half-dip in melted topping chocolate and sprinkle with crushed candy canes. Let set.

title: Cream Cheese Cinnamon Cookies
steps: Beat butter, cream cheese and dough sugars until creamy; add eggs individually. Mix in vanilla, flour, baking powder, salt and dough cinnamon, then milk gradually. Chill for 7–10 minutes.
Mix coating sugar and cinnamon. Shape small dough balls with spoons, roll in cinnamon sugar and place on parchment. Bake at 180°C fan for 8–10 minutes and drizzle with melted white chocolate.

title: Cinnamon Pecan Double Chocolate Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda, spices and salt. Fold in oats, dough pecans, white chips and chopped dough dark chocolate.
Shape 25 g balls on lined trays; bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes. Cool for 10 minutes, drizzle with melted topping chocolate and sprinkle with finely chopped topping pecans.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies with Milk
steps: Mix flour, salt and baking soda separately. Whisk egg with milk and vanilla. Cream butter with both sugars; beat in the egg mixture, then dry ingredients and chocolate chips.
Portion 1 tbsp of dough per cookie onto lined trays, leaving space. Bake at 180°C for 13 minutes.
Cool on a wire rack.

title: Peanut Butter Blossom Cookies
steps: Beat butter and peanut butter until smooth; beat in both sugars, then egg, milk and vanilla. Mix in flour, baking soda and salt. Unwrap the chocolates.
Shape small balls on lined trays and bake at 190°C for 7–9 minutes. Immediately press a chocolate kiss onto each cookie; transfer carefully with a spatula and cool.

title: Dumle Sarah Bernhardt Cookies
steps: Whisk whites and salt stiff; fold in icing sugar and almond flour. Pipe small rounds on parchment and bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes. Cool completely.
Gently melt Dumle with cream, then add milk chocolate; do not boil. Beat yolks until thick; beat in warm syrup, butter and the caramel mixture. Pipe onto bases and chill or freeze.
Dip chilled cookies in melted coating chocolate. Keep refrigerated or frozen and serve cold.

title: Vanilla Pudding Candy Cookies
steps: Beat butter, sugars, egg and vanilla for 4 minutes. Mix in flour, pudding powder, baking powder and salt for 1 minute. Briefly fold in candies and white chocolate chips.
Shape balls on lined trays and bake at 180°C for 11–12 minutes. Lift off carefully with a spatula and rest for 10 minutes.

title: American Candy Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking powder and salt; gently fold in candies. Chill for at least 30 minutes or overnight. Shape small balls and flatten slightly on lined trays.
Bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes for soft centers, or 12–14 minutes for crisp cookies.

title: Mars Brownie Bites
steps: Melt butter with chocolate and cool slightly. Mix dry ingredients, add chocolate mixture and eggs individually; stir gently just until combined.
Pour into a rectangular tin. Slice Mars bars about 0.5 cm thick and press into batter in rows. Bake at 160°C for about 30 minutes, leaving the center soft. Cool and cut into small bites.

title: Almond-Coated Jam Thumbprints
steps: Separate the egg. Cream butter and sugar; beat in yolk and vanilla, then flour. Shape small balls, dip in reserved white and coat with flaked almonds.
Place on parchment, indent each center and add a little jam. Bake at 180°C for about 10 minutes until lightly golden; cool before serving.

title: White Chocolate Cranberry Oat Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.

Mix in flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt, then oats, chocolate and cranberries. Place tablespoon portions on lined trays. Bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes and cool on trays for 10 minutes before moving.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Pretzel Cookies
steps: Mix melted, cooled butter with peanut butter and sugars; beat in egg, yolk and vanilla. Add flour, baking soda and salt, then coarsely crushed pretzels and chocolate.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C for 8–10 minutes; cool.

title: Chocolate Swirl Licorice Meringues
steps: Whisk whites and sugar until stiff; beat in icing sugar, baking powder and vanilla. Fold in licorice. Melt chocolate and drizzle half over the meringue without stirring.

Spoon half the mixture onto parchment in heaped tablespoon portions. Drizzle remaining chocolate over remaining meringue and portion it. Bake at 150°C for about 40 minutes until dry to touch. Rest before lifting from trays.

title: Rum Raisin Chocolate Oat Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then oats, chopped dark chocolate and chopped rum raisins. Chill for 30 minutes.
Arrange dough balls on lined trays with space between them. Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes; cool.
Drizzle cooled cookies with melted white chocolate.

title: Rolo-Stuffed Chocolate Hazelnut Cookies
steps: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, cocoa and baking soda, then 70 g chopped hazelnuts. Chill for 30 minutes. Wrap a tablespoon of dough around each Rolo, sealing completely. Press tops into remaining 30 g hazelnuts.
Bake nut-side up on lined trays at 180°C for about 8 minutes. Avoid overbaking so caramel stays inside. Cool and drizzle with melted white chocolate.

title: Coffee Sarah Bernhardt Cookies
steps: Whisk whites stiff and fold in finely ground almonds mixed with icing sugar. Pipe 3 cm rounds on parchment. Bake at 180°C for 10–11 minutes; cool completely.
Melt filling chocolate with coffee; stir in cold butter in pieces. Chill until thick.
Pipe filling onto bases and chill for 1 hour. Brush melted coating chocolate over filling and freeze. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Raspberry Sarah Bernhardt Cookies
steps: Whisk whites stiff and fold in finely ground almonds mixed with icing sugar. Pipe 3 cm rounds on parchment. Bake at 180°C for 10–11 minutes; cool completely.
Melt filling white chocolate over a water bath. Mix in cream cheese and raspberries, then chill until thick.
Pipe filling onto bases and chill for 1 hour. Brush melted coating chocolate over filling and freeze. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chocolate Butter Pinwheel Cookies
steps: Beat butter and icing sugar until fluffy, add dough egg, then main flour. Divide dough in half; mix cocoa into one half and extra flour into the other. Chill for 1 hour.
Roll each half to 35 × 45 cm. Separate the remaining egg; brush light dough with white, place dark dough on top and roll from a long edge. Chill for 1 hour.
Cut 0.5 cm slices, place on lined trays and brush with reserved yolk. Bake high in the oven at 200°C for about 8 minutes. Transfer immediately to a rack.

title: Florentine Cookies
steps: Chop almonds. Melt butter and sugar, stir in flour, then cream. Simmer for a few minutes until thick; remove from heat and add almonds, optional peel and cherries.
Space teaspoons well apart on parchment. Bake high in the oven at 190°C for 10–12 minutes until edges begin to brown. Cool on trays until firm.
Brush undersides with melted chocolate and leave chocolate-side up until set.

title: Cream Cheese Chocolate Nut Bites
steps: Coarsely chop nuts. Melt chocolate, butter and cream cheese over a water bath; fold in nuts and Daim balls. Spoon into candy molds or a lined tin. Chill until firm and cut if needed.
